invariants: Destination bytes must reproduce the recorded Git blob SHA.
Behavior parity must pass before any consumer cutover.
AIOps remains runtime authority until a separate revision-bound consumer migration is verified.
No company IDs, credentials, operational data, or AIOps domain policy may enter through this extraction.
FUNCTION_SLICE_SHADOW entries transfer only the named pure symbol; auth, config and write-policy authority remain at the source.
